media:group.media:title: Work From Anywhere Doesn’t Mean Work From Everywhere
media:group.media:description:
When you’re a creator and your own boss, you’re often the whole team. There’s always another idea to develop, message to answer, or post to finish. entry.title: How FoodByMaria Grew to 125K Email Subscribers

media:group.media:title: How FoodByMaria Grew to 125K Email Subscribers
media:group.media:description:
FoodByMaria rebuilt her email audience around the work that felt most authentic to her—and grew from approximately 10,000 to 125,000 email subscribers.
In this video, FoodByMaria founder and cookbook author, Maria Koutsogiannis, shares why she chose to restart an email list previously built around plant-based recipes when she pivoted to Greek content.
Maria breaks down how she and her team:
✅ Grow their email list with meal plans, PDFs, and valuable resources ✅ Use Sunday Dinner Club to attract around 1,000 subscribers per promotion ✅ Maintain approximately 50–60% open rates and 5–7.5% click rates ✅ Send three to four valuable emails each week ✅ Use Kit and Shopify to support her cookbook, olive oil, honey, app, and broader creator business ✅ Turn an engaged audience into real support for the launch of Greek Out
Maria also shares the story behind FoodByMaria—from studying accounting and waiting tables to building a food brand rooted in her Greek heritage, creating a viral stuffed-pita recipe, and publishing a cookbook that reached #2 across all cookbooks during launch week.
Her biggest lesson? Success didn’t arrive overnight. It took ten years of building, experimenting, and trusting the creative direction that felt most authentic.
